story_summary: Manual-only cases for create, update, delete flows and remaining form rules that change data.
assumptions: Run on UAT. Values in angle brackets are replaced with real accounts or data before execution
Cases that change data use synthetic titles starting "ADO-TEST" and restore or delete their data at the end
Area path is a placeholder unless ADO_AREA_PATH was set
open_questions: Which accounts exist for each role, and what is the role-to-menu matrix?
Which UAT records may be created, changed and deleted by testers?

test_cases: Verify a profile can be created with a title and appears in the search
Verify a profile title of 255 characters can be saved
Verify a profile title of 256 characters is rejected
Verify a new profile can be cloned from an existing version
Verify a new scenario can be cloned from an existing version
Verify the profile status can be changed on the Manage profile page
Verify a draft version can be deleted after the confirmation prompt
Verify a global user can be added with all required details and then revoked
Verify the global user full name is required and limited to 100 characters
Verify the global user organisation is required and limited to 100 characters
Verify an external user change is saved only after OK and validates role and sections
Verify a reference value can be added with a new value and a reason
Verify a reference value change needs a new value and a reason
Verify species maintenance asks for a species before edit, inactivate or delete
Verify a species can be edited and the change appears in the species audit trail
Verify a review comment can be edited and deleted
Verify prioritisation variables can be saved and the criterion text is limited to 255 characters
Verify cross-cutting issue scores report when there is nothing to save and when they are saved
Verify a static report can be uploaded and its version deleted
Verify a static report upload fails with a message for an unsupported file

test_cases.title: Verify a profile can be created with a title and appears in the search

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the Profile editor role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Click Create Profile in the main menu
steps.expected: The Create new profile page is displayed

steps.action: Enter "ADO-TEST <unique test title with date>" in the profile title
steps.expected: The title is shown in the title box

steps.action: Click the Create profile button
steps.expected: The profile is created and a confirmation or the Manage profile page is displayed

steps.action: Open Search disease profiles, search for the new title and click Search profiles
steps.expected: The new profile is listed in the results

steps.action: Delete the profile version created for this test (Manage profile, Delete)
steps.expected: The test data is removed

test_cases.title: Verify a profile title of 255 characters can be saved

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the Profile editor role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Search for <test profile> and click Edit Title on the first result
steps.expected: The Edit profile title page is displayed

steps.action: Enter a title of exactly 255 characters
steps.expected: The title shows 255 characters

steps.action: Click Save
steps.expected: The message "The profile title was successfully updated" is displayed

steps.action: Restore the original title and click Save
steps.expected: The message "The profile title was successfully updated" is displayed

test_cases.title: Verify a profile title of 256 characters is rejected

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the Profile editor role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Search for <test profile> and click Edit Title on the first result
steps.expected: The Edit profile title page is displayed

steps.action: Enter a title of exactly 256 characters
steps.expected: The title shows the entered characters

steps.action: Click Save
steps.expected: The message "Profile save failed: Title cannot exceed 255 characters" is displayed

steps.action: Search for <test profile> again
steps.expected: The profile still shows its original title

test_cases.title: Verify the profile status can be changed on the Manage profile page

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the Profile editor role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Search for <test profile> and click Manage on the first result

test_cases.title: Verify a draft version can be deleted after the confirmation prompt

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the Profile editor role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Manage profile page for <test profile> that has a draft version
steps.expected: The Manage profile page is displayed

steps.action: Click the Delete link
steps.expected: A confirmation prompt asking whether to delete the version is displayed

steps.action: Click Cancel on the prompt
steps.expected: The version is not deleted

steps.action: Click the Delete link again and confirm
steps.expected: The draft version is removed and the page no longer lists it

test_cases.title: Verify a global user can be added with all required details and then revoked

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the global user administration role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Click Global Users in the main menu
steps.expected: The Maintain global users page is displayed

steps.action: Click Add, enter <test username Domain\UserId> and click Look up
steps.expected: The full name, organisation and role fields are enabled

steps.action: Enter a full name, an organisation and select Profile editor in the Role list
steps.expected: The values are shown

steps.action: Click OK
steps.expected: The user appears in the global users list

steps.action: Click Delete for the new user and confirm
steps.expected: The message "The user's global role was successfully revoked" is displayed

test_cases.title: Verify the global user full name is required and limited to 100 characters

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the global user administration role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Click Global Users in the main menu
steps.expected: The Maintain global users page is displayed

steps.action: Click Add, enter <test username Domain\UserId> and click Look up
steps.expected: The full name field is enabled

steps.action: Leave the full name empty, fill the other fields and click OK
steps.expected: The message "Please enter a full name" is displayed and the user is not added

steps.action: Enter 101 characters in the full name field
steps.expected: The field holds 100 characters

steps.action: Click Cancel
steps.expected: The form closes and no user is added

test_cases.title: Verify the global user organisation is required and limited to 100 characters

steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.expected: The Maintain global users page is displayed

steps.expected: The organisation field is enabled

steps.action: Leave the organisation empty, fill the other fields and click OK
steps.expected: The message "Please enter an organisation" is displayed and the user is not added

steps.action: Enter 101 characters in the organisation field
steps.expected: The field holds 100 characters

steps.action: Click Cancel

test_cases.title: Verify an external user change is saved only after OK and validates role and sections

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the external user administration role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Click External Users in the main menu
steps.expected: The Maintain external users page is displayed

steps.action: Click Edit for <test external user>
steps.expected: The profiles for that user are listed

steps.action: Click Add for a profile and click OK without choosing a role
steps.expected: The message "Please select a valid role." is displayed

steps.action: Choose a role, untick every section and click OK
steps.expected: The message "At least one section must be ticked." is displayed

steps.action: Tick at least one section and click OK, then save the user
steps.expected: The message "The changes to the external user were saved successfully." is displayed

steps.action: Make a change and leave without clicking OK
steps.expected: The message "You have pending changes. To save these changes, click the OK button." is displayed

test_cases.title: Verify a reference value can be added with a new value and a reason

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the reference data administration role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Click Maintain Reference Data in the main menu
steps.expected: The Maintain reference data page is displayed

steps.action: Select the <reference table> and click Add reference value
steps.expected: The new value and reason fields are enabled

steps.action: Enter "ADO-TEST <unique value>" in the new value field and a reason in the reason field
steps.expected: The values are shown

steps.action: Click Save
steps.expected: The message "Reference value change successfully saved" is displayed

steps.action: Click View audit trail
steps.expected: The audit trail lists the change with the reason entered

test_cases.title: Verify a reference value change needs a new value and a reason

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the reference data administration role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Click Maintain Reference Data in the main menu
steps.expected: The Maintain reference data page is displayed

steps.action: Select the <reference table> and click Add reference value
steps.expected: The new value and reason fields are enabled

steps.action: Leave both fields empty and click Save
steps.expected: The messages "You need to provide a new value" and "You need to provide a reason for this change" are displayed

steps.action: Enter 256 characters in the new value field
steps.expected: The field holds 255 characters

steps.action: Click Cancel
steps.expected: No reference value is added

steps.expected: The message "Please select a species to edit" is displayed

steps.action: Click Inactivate without selecting a species
steps.expected: The message "Please select a species to inactivate" is displayed

steps.action: Click Delete without selecting a species

test_cases.title: Verify a species can be edited and the change appears in the species audit trail

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as <D2R2 account with the species data administration role>
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Click Maintain Species Data in the main menu
steps.expected: The Maintain species data page is displayed

steps.action: Select <test species> and click Edit
steps.expected: The edit form opens with the current name

steps.action: Change the name to "ADO-TEST <unique name>" and click Save

steps.action: Click View audit trail

test_cases.title: Verify a review comment can be edited and deleted
